title: ApplicationDestroyStatus
description: How the teardown Application.destroy ran ended. | Status | Meaning | |---|---| | `completed` | Every teardown step `destroy()` runs or waits for settled without a failure | | `completedWithErrors` | Every step ran to its end, but at least one of them failed | | `forced` | Scene teardown outlived the grace period and was abandoned; the rest of the engine was released anyway | `forced` wins over `completedWithErrors`: when both happened the status is `forced`, and the failures are still listed in ApplicationDestroyOutcome.errors.
